Happy 77th Birthday, Tim Curry!
The actor was born today in Cheshire, England in 1946. His first huge acting performance was as the original Dr. Frank-N-Furter in the stage version of The Rocky Horror Show (1973). When it was made into a film in 1975, he reprised his role which shot him to critical acclaim. He continued his stage work, but branched into film by the 80’s as Daniel Francis “Rooster” Hannigan in the 1982 film version of Annie, and as Jeremy Hancock in the political film The Ploughman’s Lunch. Two of my personal favorites was as Wadsworth in the movie Clue (1985) and Mr. Hector, the Plaza Hotel concierge in Home Alone 2: Lost in New York. One of Curry’s best-known television roles (and best-known roles overall) is as Pennywise the Clown in the 1990 horror miniseries Stephen King’s It. 

As a result of a stroke in 2012, he has shifted the voice acting but in October 2020, he reprised his role as Dr. Frank-N-Furter in a live table reading of The Rocky Horror Picture Show.
